CustomField.description: True when TODAY() falls between the related Academic Term Start Date and End Date (inclusive).
CustomField.formula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(AcademicTermId)), NOT(ISBLANK(AcademicTerm.StartDate)), NOT(ISBLANK(AcademicTerm.EndDate)), TODAY() >= DATEVALUE(AcademicTerm.StartDate), TODAY() <= DATEVALUE(AcademicTerm.EndDate) )
CustomField.label: Term Active?
